jq.name: one tool reads, and asks for read-write access only for a call that sets save
jq.expr: (.manifest.plugins | length) == 1 and (plugin("image_tools") | .bind_dir | .access == "read_write" and .write_fields == ["save"] and .input_field == "path" and .original_field == "path_original") and (plugin("image_tools") | .input_schema.properties | has("save") and has("output"))

jq.name: the input schema is closed and offers every operation
jq.expr: (plugin("image_tools") | .input_schema | .additionalProperties == false and (.properties.op.enum == (ops | map(if . == "montage" then ., "contact_sheet" else . end))) and (.properties.ops.maxItems == 16))

jq.name: the instructions document every operation by name in its steps table
the limits are declared and under the host ceilings
the helper agent is granted exactly the plugin and nothing else
the graph nodes run the plugin and every output collection has a schema
the agent prompt holds concepts and leaves syntax to the tool
jq.expr: .assets["agent_behaviors/image_helper/system_prompt.md"] | contains("`view`") and contains("`info`") and (contains("cursor") | not) and (contains("overwrite") | not)

jq.name: no em dash or en dash anywhere in the pack's text
the notice records every runtime crate and says nothing is embedded
jq.expr: .assets["notice.md"] | contains("embeds no model or data file") and contains("rxing") and contains("fast_image_resize") and contains("font8x8") and contains("image-rs")
